---
name: Performance issue
about: Performance issue with SHORK, included software or feature
title: "*Insert software/feature name* performance issue"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Scenario**
Describe the performance issue you experienced and what you were doing when you experienced it. Illustrate with screenshots/photos if you think they can help.

**Reproducing**
Please outline how one may recreate the scenario. For example, what to run and/or press to get to where you experienced performance issues.

**Attempted resolutions**
If you tried to investigate the issue and improve performance yourself, please let me know what you tried.

**SHORK version**
Please state the version of SHORK (486/DISC/DISKETTE) you are running, and if SHORK 486, its build type (Mini/Default/Plus/etc.) Even better, you can attach your after-build report (`images/report.txt`).

**Hardware**
Please list your device name, CPU, RAM, swap (if present) and free disk space. If networking-related, please also include details of your networking hardware. If running in a virtual machine, please provide its configuration.

**Additional context**
Anything else you think is relevant or helpful.
